title: 2026年校队成员选拔结果公示
excerpt: 10.15校队选拔第一轮结束：高二(3)班陶锦源战胜社长进入校队，高二校队自此满员；高一24名参选者中12名同学晋级第二轮选拔（三局两胜，对手为社长及副社长），综合实力约前50%可最终入队
content:
## 2026年校队成员选拔结果公示

各位社员，经过10月15日的校队选拔，现公示结果如下：

**高二组**：共11位同学参加了选拔，主要与社长进行了一局定胜负的较量。高二同学的选拔仅设一轮，恭喜**高二(3)班陶锦源**成功进入校队，成为最后进入高二校队的一员，自此**高二校队满员**。

**高一组**：共24人参加了第一轮选拔，在淘汰掉50%后，恭喜12名晋级同学成功进入第二轮选拔。第二轮选拔的形式仍是一场三局两胜比赛，选拔人员为社长及副社长。最终综合实力约前50%的同学可进入校队，正式成为**武汉外国语学校乒乓球校队的2026级队员**。

祝大家第二轮选拔顺利！
excerpt_en: Round 1 of the 15 October selection is done: TAO Jinyuan (Grade 11, Class 3) beat the president to take the last Grade-11 spot, completing that cohort. From 24 Grade-10 entrants, 12 have advanced to round 2 — a best-of-three against the president and vice presidents; roughly the top half by overall strength will make the 2026 squad.
content_en:
## 2026 School Team Selection: Round 1 Results

Dear club members, here are the results of the 15 October school team selection:

**Grade 11**: 11 students took part, playing one-game deciders mainly against the president. The Grade-11 selection had only one round — congratulations to **TAO Jinyuan (Grade 11, Class 3)** on making the team as its final member. The Grade-11 squad is now complete.

**Grade 10**: 24 students played round 1; after eliminating half, congratulations to the 12 students advancing to round 2. Round 2 is again a best-of-three match, played against the president and the vice presidents. Roughly the top half by overall strength will make the cut and officially become members of the **2026 cohort of the WFLS table tennis school team**.

Good luck in round 2!
